summary.title: The Moon Falls: The Weft vs. The Deep — Campaign Finale
summary.synopsis: The 13th Realm crashes into Althein as the Weft battles the Deep and Kharkov atop the pyramid. After the moon vaporizes the party (except Lev, sheltered in the lighthouse), Divex's Codex of Renewal resurrects them six seconds later. The Deep recongeals from scattered remains, and the party finishes it in a brutal second phase — Henrik's thorn-spike assault bookending the campaign's first and last attacks. The lighthouse then quarantines Althein, carries the party through a crystal sphere to a new world, and the Weft broadcasts their victory across Althein: 'We are the Weft.'
key_beats: Henrik strikes the Deep, triggering rupture which frees Lev from being swallowed (though still restrained); Henrik hands Lev a matchstick before descending.
Dawn destroys four binding-point plants, triggering a blue fungal column that stuns the Deep for 6 — preventing it from using Kharkov as a shield when the moon lands.
The Deep casts Garden of the Green Man's Growth, creating difficult terrain; Divex deflects magic with the Badge of Mercuromancy.
Lev escapes restraint with a natural 20, then dimension doors into the lighthouse where he meets Ito, an elderly blue-skinned Duskwalker janitor who offers coffee and vodka.
The 13th Realm (a moon) crashes down, dealing 343 bludgeoning damage (reduced to ~321 after resistance) — vaporizing Henrik, Dawn, and Divex instantly, and destroying the Deep's body.

Divex's Codex of Renewal resurrects the party six seconds later with 20 HP and regeneration 20 for four rounds; the party uses the breather to heal and damage the Deep's scattered remains (Divex casts 9th-level Desiccate via Wish).

The Deep recongeals, burnt and on fire; combat resumes. An earthquake splits it into two Effigies of Sin. The party chips away with Henrik's criticals, Lev's vulnerability/intensify strikes, and Divex's chain lightning.
Divex attempts to counterspell a Prismatic Sphere; the Deep's stupefied condition (maintained by Lev and Dawn) causes the cast to fail on a flat check — saving the party from a devastating spell.
Henrik lands a critical hit with Yamaraj's Grandeur, dealing 105+ damage and killing the final Effigy of Sin with a cone of thorns — the same thorn-spike attack that opened the campaign.

The party retreats to the lighthouse; Ito explains the lighthouse will quarantine Althein and move on. The lighthouse cracks through a crystal sphere and lands on a new, unnamed planet (Campaign 3's setting).

The party leaves items on the new world, returns to Althein via anchorways, and broadcasts a planet-wide message via the Bifurcated Man's favor: 'We are the Weft.' They plan a Council of All Things at Thyropay.

Post-game Q&A reveals unresolved threads: the Crystal Point Lattice (piloted by a quarry, allied with the Dark Bramble), Dahl's whereabouts off-Althein, Grimm's haven-spreading plan, Tech's deal with the Lighthouse, and the Palladium spikes plot the party ignored.
locations: The Lighthouse (interior — resonance crystal, Ito's quarters, doors 101–105)
New planet beyond the crystal sphere (forest landing site)
summary.cliffhanger: The Weft broadcasts 'We are the Weft' to all of Althein and plans a Council of All Things at Thyropay, ushering in a new era — while the lighthouse has carried them to a new, unknown planet with six magical frequencies, setting the stage for Campaign 3. The epilogue session remains to be played.
